mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from prior month signal weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain disruption that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1.3 million units signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1.3 million units, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low payroll growth (below 100k) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.2% from prior month) indicate labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 100k and UNRATE rises > 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
